_comment: Shared config for utils/* and pipeline.py. CLI flags override these.

llm._comment_model: Default per spec ('gpt41mini'). The tu-zi gateway prices gpt-4.1-mini but NOT 'openai/gpt-4.1-mini' (model_price_error), so use the bare name.

classify._comment_categories: Primary categories from docs/taxonomy.md. Per the spec, classification is at the top level only.
classify._comment_primary: When true, only one primary label is requested; secondary labels are ignored.

split._comment_strategy: Stratified (by primary category) and repo-disjoint: once a repo lands in the train set, no other issues from that repo appear in the test set.
